name: LPCXpresso55S69
description: Dual Cortex-M33 (150 MHz, TrustZone) LPCXpresso board with on-board Link2 CMSIS-DAP/J-Link debug probe, Arduino and mikroBUS headers, Pmod, microSD, audio codec and USB host/device.
notes: Order code LPC55S69-EVK. On-board Link2 debug probe supports CMSIS-DAP and SEGGER J-Link firmware; includes MMA8652 accelerometer, stereo audio codec with line in/out, high-speed and full-speed USB ports.

Prices vary widely (NXP $84.77 pending stock, Mouser ~$75, Newark ~$69, DigiKey ~$104); the older figure of about $50 is gone. External flash size was not verified (flashMB counts only the 640 KB internal flash). Board size and GPIO count are approximate.
